messages:
maya: Heads-up — pricing/packaging change for beta on 2024-05-15: new 'Pro-Embed' tier + per-embedding unit price update. Need cross-team check on metering, billing mapping, quota wiring, and contract exemptions. cc @sam @li-billing @priya-eng @alex-finance

sam: Metering update: server now emits usage_unit=embedding_token from canary. Client SDK patch merged. Still waiting on the billing mapping API and a staging e2e test to validate invoice items.

li-billing: Billing note: we'll accept embedding_token but need explicit SKU -> invoice_item mapping and a contract_exempt boolean for deals that override pricing. Also need the list of enterprise customers to be exempted.

priya-eng: Quotas: current enforcement is tokens/sec. We'll add an adapter to translate per-request embedding_token -> tokens/sec for the quota service. I have a small PR in flight (wip #542). Estimated finish: Fri EOD unless the concurrent multi-embed case blocks me.

alex-finance: Finance asks for SKU list + expected monthly volume bands so we can re-evaluate discount tiers and reserved capacity adjustments. Also need an exportable monthly CSV of embedding volume for 13-month retention for audits.

maya: Action items recap:
- Metering emitter: sam (canary)
- Billing mapping API + contract_exempt flag: sam + li-billing
- Quota adapter + wiring: priya-eng
- Contract opt-out CSV: li-billing (send by EOD)
- Finance volumes and SKU bands: alex-finance
Blockers: missing SKU names and opt-out list. If both land, staging smoke test can proceed.

li-billing: Sent CSV to private ops channel and emailed finance. File contains account_id, deal_id, override_flag.

sam: Mapping API PR opened to staging: https://ci/repo/pulls/1285. Added contract_exempt boolean and tests for exempt accounts.

priya-eng: PR #542 opened for quota adapter. One failing test around concurrent multi-embed; debugging now.

deploy-bot: deploy status: staging build #489 succeeded. Integration tests: 86/92 passed (2 flaky, 4 fail in embedding e2e)

maya: If everyone can validate staging smoke by tomorrow noon PST, we keep beta date. If not, propose 1-week slip. Thanks all :thumbsup:
